traceability.notes: No matching bootstrap PDF-list record found (likely a certificate added/renamed after the bootstrap PDF was issued); no renewal history or validation-scope text available yet. Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: No certificate number was found anywhere in the visible pages provided (cover page shows title, expert lab, client, but no explicit certificate number like '3M 01/09-04/03A'). The relative trueness table extracted (Table 2, page 15) is for the 'Pour plate' inoculation modality, chosen as the primary/canonical protocol; a parallel table for 'Surface spreading' modality exists with nearly identical values (MP 0.03/0.27/17; DP -0.02/0.15/19; SP 0.01/0.14/16; V -0.05/0.22/16; CF 0.03/0.20/17; ES 0.02/0.12/19; All cat. 0.00/0.19/104) and is not recorded here since it is an alternative protocol variant. 'All categories' rows for both modalities (n=103 and n=104) were excluded as aggregate totals, not individual food categories. Category abbreviations were expanded per the legend in Figure 6/7 (MP=Meat products, DP=Dairy products, SFP/SP=Seafood products, VP/V=Vegetables, CF=Composite foods, ES=Environmental samples). Acceptability limit of ±0.5 log10 is confirmed from Table 11 and figures 8/9/12.
